title: Pop-up booth setup and expense sprint notebook
content:
Purpose: quick, portable scratchpad for the Redwood pop-up booth at SF Developer Week — logistics, vendor contacts, receipt guidance, and setup timeline. Treat as working notes; will extract into the formal postmortem and expense packet later.

Summary (top tasks)
- Confirm crate arrival + local storage by 9/26 (vendor: BayShip).
- Finalize AV order (AVX Bay Area) and confirm run-of-show for demo loops.
- Print 10x name badges and 2x quick-reference cheat sheets for booth demos.
- Assign expense leads: Priya (receipts / expense packet), Ethan (on-site petty cash), Marta (swag manager).

Before travel (checklist)
- Shipments
  - Create shipping label to "Moscone West — Redwood Inference / Booth #B12". Use UPS account (acct ends 3342). Tracking to be posted in #events-sf.
  - Include 'return shipping label' in crate for immediate pickup.
- Booth assets to pack: two A/V crates (monitors + mounts), 1 demo laptop, 1 switch, promotional table runner, 150 stickers, 50 postcards, 2 rollups.
- Printouts: cheat sheets x2, one-pagers for sales leads x100.
- Cards & cash: bring corporate card + $200 petty cash in labeled envelope for cab tips/last-minute parking.
- Confirm hotel block and check-in window; ensure receipts are saved for reimbursement.

Day-of setup (timeline) — target times for faster handoff
- 06:30 — Crew meet at hotel lobby, quick inventory, pack small tools kit (zip ties, gaffer tape, multi-tool).
- 07:30 — Arrive loading dock at Moscone, check-in with show office, confirm booth location and power.
- 08:00 — Unload crates; AV vendor begins monitor mounts and network setup.
- 09:15 — Run basic power-on sequence for demo laptop; confirm network access and demo environment.
- 10:00 — Booth ready for media drop / press; handoff to floor lead for initial staff rotation.

Roles & quick contact list
- Priya Khatri — onsite logistics / receipts (mobile: +1-415-555-0189) [primary expense compiler].
- Ethan Ross — petty cash & vendor point (mobile: +1-415-555-0122) [handles deliveries & immediate purchases].
- Marta Alvarez — swag + lead capture (mobile: +1-415-555-0133) [counts inventory, coordinates shipping back].
- AV vendor: AVX Bay Area — tech lead: Marco Ruiz (mruiz@avxbay.com, +1-415-555-0901). Booked under PO# EVT-334.
- Shipping: BayShip Logistics — contact: Sheila Tran (ship@bayship.com, +1-510-555-0707). Pickup window: 18:00 on final day.
- Local storage: CityBox SF — unit reserved (code: RBW-DEVWEEK) — pick-up contact: Aaron (aaron@cityboxsf.com).

Expense capture rules (quick reminders)
- Required for any reimbursement: date, vendor name, itemized amount, payment method, and a photo of the original receipt. If digital, forward the invoice PDF to expenses@redwood.com with subject: "EXP-DEVWEEK #[short-desc]".
- Naming convention for photos: 202410xx_vendor_amount_shortdesc.jpg (helps when compiling packet).
- Personal card use: if used, note reason and submit in the same cycle; attach copy of corporate card decline or manager note if available.
- Meals: follow per-diem rules (see linked policy CONFLUENCE-TRAVEL-2024). Team dinners must include attendee list + business purpose.
- Swag purchases: code as "Marketing - Promo Swag" and tag with project EVT-DEVWEEK-2024. Include invoice and packing list.

Petty cash flow (on-site)
- Float: $200 in envelope labeled "DEVWEEK PETTY — Priya".
- Use cases: taxi fares for speakers, small office supplies, urgent printing. Track each disbursement on the paper log inside envelope; photo log daily.
- Reconcile: hand receipts + log to accounting at close of show.

Receipt priorities / what to OCR first
- Hotel folio (itemize room + taxes + minibar).
- Shuttle / taxi / rideshare receipts (save invoices with mileage if personal car).
- Booth rental + electrical/Internet charges (these go to event cost center).
- AV invoice and any on-floor labor time (note overtime hours separately).
- Catering meeting invoice (if client dinners occurred).

Expense categories (for quick expense form selection)
- Event - Booth Rental
- Event - Electrical/Internet
- Marketing - Promo Swag
- Travel - Lodging
- Travel - Transportation
- Meals - Business
- Logistics - Shipping & Handling
- Misc - Petty Cash

VAT / Sales tax notes (for future non-US events)
- If overseas, request VAT invoices in supplier's native format. Tag these receipts as "VAT" so tax team can process. For US shows ignore VAT tag.

On-floor quick hacks / troubleshooting
- If demo wifi fails: switch to local hotspot (Ethan's phone) and disable VPNs. Keep the offline demo bundle (HTML demo + recorded transcript) on thumbdrive.
- Monitor flicker or HDMI handshake: reboot monitor, reseat cable, try alternative DP cable in crate B.
- Badge printer jam: use the 3 spare printable badge sheets in folder labeled "PRINT SPARES".

Post-show wrap-up (priority list)
- Day 1 post-show (EOD): compile photos of all receipts and upload to shared drive folder /events/devweek/receipts. Tag each with expense category and owner.
- Day 2: submit consolidated expense packet to finance (subject: "EXP-DEVWEEK — Booth + Travel — Priya"). Include: PDF of receipts, petty cash log, shipping invoices, AV invoice.
- Day 5: follow up on vendor returns and confirm return shipping tracking.

Common gotchas and lessons learned (quick notes for this run)
- Always attach proof of credit card authorization for third-party vendors (some will only invoice to company name).
- Print at least two extra demo cheat sheets — attendees rip them up for notes.
- Label cables and power strips clearly with masking tape: this saves ~20–30 min on floor setup.

Quick templates (copy/paste)
- Slack status for team: "@channel Live from Moscone West — Booth B12. Priya on logistics, Ethan petty cash, Marta swag. DM for immediate help".
- Email to accounting (subject): "EXP-DEVWEEK — [Your Name] — Submission" (body: short list of what’s attached + total requested).

Open questions / TODOs (to resolve before final packet)
- Confirm whether AVX overtime rates apply past 18:00 on Day 3 (PENDING Marco).
- Confirm final headcount for swag distribution (Marta to confirm by 10/08).
- Obtain a digital copy of the Moscone electrical order; attach to expense packet (Ethan follow-up).

Endnotes: This page is intentionally messy — use as the single-source working doc while on the ground. Will consolidate into the formal expense submission and the postmortem doc on Confluence after show close.

Last updated: 2024-10-12 by Priya Khatri
